opportunities.title: Ph.D. in Computer Science
opportunities.description: Official Stanford CS graduate admissions materials state that there is one admissions cycle for starting in the Autumn quarter. For Ph.D. applicants, the application opens mid-September, the application deadline is 8 December 2026, and decisions are in February 2027. Applicants must apply either to the MS (including HCP) or PhD program, not to both.
opportunities.eligibility: Official materials require application to either MS or PhD, not both. All application deadlines are final; applications are not accepted after the deadline.

opportunities.title: Master's in Computer Science
opportunities.description: Official Stanford CS graduate admissions materials list a Master's application for Autumn entry, opening mid-September, deadline 8 December 2026, with decisions in March 2027. Official note: applicants must apply either to MS (including HCP) or PhD, not both.
opportunities.eligibility: Official materials require application to either MS or PhD, not both.
